summary: Euroholdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting quarterly and six-month results for periods ended June 30, 2026. It announced net revenues, net income, adjusted EBITDA, and a quarterly dividend of $0.14 per share. It also noted the expected delivery of an MR product tanker vessel acquired from a related party, financed with own funds and bank debt including a $10 million loan. This is a routine earnings announcement with ordinary operational updates, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
